content.name: Two Buttons
content.description:
Vasya 发现了一个奇怪的装置。该装置面板上有一个红色按钮、一个蓝色按钮和一个显示屏，显示着某个正整数。按下红色按钮后，装置会将当前显示的数字乘以 $2$；按下蓝色按钮后，会将显示屏上的数字减一。如果某一时刻显示屏上的数字不再为正整数，装置就会损坏。显示屏可以显示任意大的数字。最初，显示屏上显示的数字为 $n$。

Bob 想要让显示屏上的数字变为 $m$。请问最少需要按多少次按钮，才能将显示屏上的数字从 $n$ 变为 $m$？
content.formatI: 输入仅包含一行，包括两个不同的整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$1 \leq n, m \leq 10^{4}$），用一个空格隔开。
content.formatO: 输出一个整数，表示最少需要按按钮的次数，才能将数字从 $n$ 变为 $m$。
content.hint:
在第一个样例中，需要先按一次蓝色按钮，然后按一次红色按钮。

在第二个样例中，不需要进行倍增操作，只需连续按九次蓝色按钮即可。

en.name: Two Buttons
en.description:
Vasya has found a strange device. On the front panel of a device there are: a red button, a blue button and a display showing some positive integer. After clicking the red button, device multiplies the displayed number by two. After clicking the blue button, device subtracts one from the number on the display. If at some point the number stops being positive, the device breaks down. The display can show arbitrarily large numbers. Initially, the display shows number $ n $ .

Bob wants to get number $ m $ on the display. What minimum number of clicks he has to make in order to achieve this result?
en.formatI: The first and the only line of the input contains two distinct integers $ n $ and $ m $ ( $ 1<=n,m<=10^{4} $ ), separated by a space .
en.formatO: Print a single number — the minimum number of times one needs to push the button required to get the number $ m $ out of number $ n $ .
en.hint:
In the first example you need to push the blue button once, and then push the red button once.

In the second example, doubling the number is unnecessary, so we need to push the blue button nine times.
